newsitem.title: USA: Rally's ends merger talks with Checkers.
newsitem.headline: Rally's ends merger talks with Checkers.

text.p: Rally's Hamburgers Inc. and Checkers Drive-In Restaurants Inc. said Monday they have scrapped plans to merge because they could not get favourable accounting treatment from Securities and Exchange Commission.
Under the terms of a letter of intent signed March 25, each of Rally's outstanding shares was to be converted into three Checkers common shares.
The drive-through hamburger restaurant chains had agreed to merge as a way to cut costs and fight the three burger giants -- McDonald's, Burger King and Wendy's -- for market share.
Rally's, based in Louisville, Ky., operates 473 restaurants primarily in the Midwest.
Checkers, based in Clearwater, Fla., has 478 restaurants mainly in the Southeast.
Rally's stock edged up 6.25 cents to $2.97 early on Nasdaq. Checkers fell 37.5 cents to $27.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
